correctness.rationale: The claim is restricted to the explicitly defined union of the \(28\) source Table-7 coprimality certificates. For every seed pair, \(f_1(a)=f_1(b)\) is independently recomputed, and \(\gcd(c,ab)=1\) gives \(\varphi(ca)=\varphi(c)\varphi(a)\) and the analogous identity for \(b\), proving the propagated collision. The union is periodic modulo the squarefree product of \(36\) relevant primes. An exact residue-state recurrence counts all residue classes, giving the stated numerator, denominator, and decimal. No sampling or asymptotic approximation is used for the certificate density.

value.rationale: The source explicitly asks whether noninjectivity holds for every \(c\) and uses asymptotic density as quantitative evidence toward that question. The new result exactly saturates the source's entire published Table-7 collision dataset, raising the certified lower density from \(98.1728\%\) to \(99.6810117658\ldots\%\). This is an exact natural invariant of the full published certificate family, and it reduces the uncovered proportion by a factor exceeding \(5.7\), while clearly separating that finite-certificate conclusion from the still-open all-\(c\) statement.
